Sterile Disposable Minor Procedure Dressing Pack

procedures.indication: Subacute persistent knee effusion following sports injury
procedures.preoperativeAssessment: Cardiopulmonary clearance obtained. Coagulation profile PT/INR 1.05 within normal limits.
procedures.operativeFindings: Mild synovial hypertrophy; medial and lateral menisci intact; articular cartilage Grade 1 chondromalacia.
procedures.procedureNotes: Aseptic prep and drape completed. Anteromedial and anterolateral portals established. 150ml clear synovial fluid aspirated and sent for microscopy. Thorough normal saline lavage performed. Portals closed with 3-0 Ethilon.
procedures.complications: None reported. Minimal blood loss (<15 ml).
procedures.postoperativeCondition: Stable, alert, neurovascular status intact in affected limb.
procedures.carePlan: Ice pack application 20 mins every 4 hours. Compression bandage for 48 hours. Oral analgesics as prescribed.
procedures.followUpInstructions: Suture removal and wound check scheduled in 7 days at Ortho OPD Room 104.
